purpose: Author the contract for a new capability via OpenSpec.
instructions: Run the OpenSpec propose flow for the approved request. Write the change (proposal, design, delta specs, tasks) into {{change_dir}} inside the stage directory. Report where the contract lives so the orchestrator can record contract_ref. On re-entry after a spec-contradiction or a send-back, revise the same change to resolve the recorded objection instead of starting over.
restrictions: MUST NOT modify the repository or the main checkout.
MUST NOT write .harness/ or any long-term memory.
MUST NOT write routing state (state.json) or the event log (log.ndjson).
MUST NOT write outside its stage directory.

params.change_dir: Stage-relative directory for the OpenSpec change
